{{short description|Portuguese academic and chemist}}
'''João J. R. Fraústo da Silva''' ([[Tomar]], August 30, 1933 – June 10, 2022) was a [[Portuguese people|Portuguese]] [[chemist]].<ref>[http://cqe.ist.utl.pt/personal_pages/pages/frausto_silva.php João J. R. Fraústo da Silva] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150707091715/http://cqe.ist.utl.pt/personal_pages/pages/frausto_silva.php |date=2015-07-07 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=NOVA University Lisbon mourns the death of its Founding Rector João Fraústo Da Silva |url=https://novalaw.unl.pt/en/note-of-condolence-joao-frausto-da-silva-1933-2022/ |publisher=Nova School of Law |access-date=14 September 2023}}</ref>

Fraústo da Silva received his degree in industrial chemical engineering from the [[Instituto Superior Técnico]] in 1958 and his D.Phil.  in chemistry working with [[Harry Irving (chemist)]] at the [[University of Oxford]] in 1962.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Green |first1=M. L. H. |last2=Williams |first2=R. J. P. |title=An appreciation of the collaboration between the inorganic chemistry laboratory at Oxford and the Instituto Superior Tecnico at Lisbon brought about by Prof. J.J.R. Fraústo da Silva |journal=Inorg. Chim. Acta |date=2003 |volume=356 |pages=6–7 |doi=10.1016/S0020-1693(03)00331-1 |url=https://doi.org/10.1016/S0020-1693(03)00331-1 |access-date=14 May 2023|url-access=subscription }}</ref> He held several positions throughout his career, which features:

*Director of the Instituto Superior Técnico of the [[Technical University of Lisbon]];<ref>[http://narq.tecnico.ulisboa.pt/extensao-cultural-e-educativa/exposicoes-fisicas-eou-virtuais/100-anos-ist-dos-directores-aos-presidentes/ Directors of Instituto Superior Técnico]</ref>
*President's Office of Research and Planning of Educational Action (GEPAE) of the Ministry of Education;
*First Rector of the [[Universidade Nova de Lisboa]];
*Minister of Education and Universities in the VIII Constitutional Government of Portugal;
*President of the National Institute of Public Administration;
*President of the Foundation [[Cultural Centre of Belém]];<ref>[http://www.ccb.pt/sites/ccb/en-EN/Pages/default.aspx Cultural Centre of Belém] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110702000914/http://www.ccb.pt/sites/ccb/en-EN/Pages/default.aspx |date=2011-07-02 }}</ref>
*Chairman of the Board of Trustees of the Foundation Oriente.<ref>[http://www.foriente.pt/ Foundation Oriente]</ref>
